text: Value creation and capture in decentralized finance markets: Non-fungible tokens as a class of digital assets presents the following source proposition: Especially, non-fungible token (NFT) assets within DeFi are redefining how value is created and disseminated, for instance, in the art industry. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Exit by selling reputation tokens is more problematic for reputation than for other cryptocurrency tokens, because reputation is less fungible: a token's value is tied to the specific post in which the reputation was created and is subject to separate review.
